research_question: Does separating the full-frame VACE conditioning mask from the local final-compositing mask remove the black Canny-background artifact observed in E2?
answer: Yes for the interface failure. The severe black-background artifact disappeared in both frozen seed-1 cases, while action and appearance quality remain case-dependent.

mask_contract.vace_conditioning_mask: None, converted by the frozen runtime to an all-one full-generation mask
mask_contract.final_projection_mask: frozen shared_alpha.png, used only after generation
mask_contract.legacy_error: E2 passed the local final-compositing alpha to the VACE condition encoder, causing the black-background Canny video to enter the inactive/preserved branch outside the local support.

cake.action_observation: The fork approaches, contacts and lifts a separated cake piece across the six review frames.
cake.remaining_issue: A conspicuous dark mask-shaped support/shadow region remains around and behind the fork, so strict photo success is not established.

noodle.action_observation: The chopsticks approach, contact and lift a noodle strand across the six review frames.
noodle.remaining_issue: The source bowl remains visually full and source depletion is unclear, so source conservation and non-duplication are not established.

decision.recommended_next_test: Freeze a separate multi-seed confirmation with the corrected VACE mask, then reduce the final projection support to a per-frame or softly feathered mask and add an explicit source-depletion constraint.

claim_limit: Two development cases and one seed validate only the identified interface correction. They do not establish generalization, statistical effectiveness, source conservation, physical correctness, photo realism or superiority over VACE.
